item.title: manadia Global Launch: A Trusted AI Prediction Ecosystem Enters The Era of Value Internet
item.content:encoded:
In recent years, the development of artificial intelligence has far exceeded market expectations. From breakthroughs in large-scale models to the rapid rise of AI Agents, from enterprise AI applications to continued investments in global computing infrastructure by major tech giants, AI is shifting from a technological revolution to an industrial revolution.

Increasingly, work is being performed by AI, decisions are being assisted by AI, and value is being generated by AI. However, a critical question is being repeatedly raised across the industry: when AI begins to create value, who records that value? Who verifies it? And who distributes it?

Most current AI systems remain at the stage of “content generation” and “task execution,” lacking a complete value-bearing framework. AI can generate predictions, produce business insights, and execute intelligent decisions, yet the value behind these capabilities is difficult to continuously record and accumulate.

In the future, competition in the AI industry may no longer be solely about model capability, but about who can build a new network that carries AI-generated value. Among them, predictive capability is becoming one of the most important entry points to value in this era.

From Predicting the Future to Creating Value: manadia Redefines the Prediction Economy

Prediction has never been a simple problem. Whether in capital markets, corporate operations, or societal systems, all fundamentally rely on judgments about the future. Stronger predictive ability leads to higher resource allocation efficiency; more accurate predictions lead to stronger value creation.

In traditional systems, predictive power is concentrated in a small number of institutions and professional groups. In the AI era, however, large models, AI Agents, and intelligent collaborative networks are making predictive capabilities scalable and continuously optimizable for the first time.

\ It is in this context that manadia was born. As the world’s first trusted AI prediction ecosystem, manadia is built on an AI-native computing power collaboration network, connecting AI Agents, prediction markets, global payment systems, and yield networks to create a new value system centered around predictive capability.

In manadia’s view, prediction is not only an outcome but also a value-generating behavior. Every model invocation, every agent collaboration, every predictive action, and every ecosystem interaction can form verifiable, traceable, and accumulative value contributions that continuously flow back into the network.

Prediction capability is evolving from a tool into an asset, and the prediction economy is moving from concept to reality.

AI-Native Compute Collaboration Network: Building the Next-Generation Intelligent Economy Infrastructure

With the arrival of the AI Agent era, the future AI landscape will no longer be dominated by a single model. A large number of specialized AI Agents will participate in prediction, analysis, decision-making, and execution, collaboratively completing complex tasks in real time. How to organize these agents, coordinate different models, and enable value sharing has become a core infrastructure challenge for the AI industry.

The AI-native compute collaboration network proposed by manadia is designed precisely for this trend. Through a unified collaborative architecture, different AI Agents can perform prediction, validation, execution, and value distribution within the same network, forming a continuously improving intelligent collaboration system.

As more agents join the network, predictive capability strengthens; as predictive capability improves, ecosystem value expands; and as ecosystem value grows, more participants are attracted into the network.

This reinforcing network effect is driving manadia’s evolution from a prediction product into foundational infrastructure for the AI Value Internet.

Top-Tier Capital and Ecosystem Resources Are Converging Around manadia

For any emerging sector, technology defines the ceiling, while ecosystem determines the speed.

manadia has completed a $7 million funding round, with participation from OKX Ventures, Polygon co-founder Sandeep Nailwal, Pillar VC, One Way Ventures, Quasar Holding, and other prominent institutional investors and industry figures. The project has also been listed on RootData. In addition, it has received ecosystem support from OK Ventures, Polygon ecosystem, and AUR Labs.

These institutions span AI, Web3, infrastructure, and global venture investment. Their participation reflects not only financial validation but also a strong belief in the long-term potential of the AI prediction sector. As AI and blockchain convergence enters a new phase, predictive capability, intelligent coordination networks, and value internet infrastructure are becoming key industry focus areas.

manadia stands at the intersection of this trend.

UMXM Completes Global Liquidity Deployment, Ecosystem Opening in June

As the core token of the manadia ecosystem, UMXM plays a key role in value circulation, network incentives, prediction market interactions, and yield network coordination. UMXM has been listed on Bitget, Kraken, MEXC and KuCoin, completing its global liquidity infrastructure deployment and providing essential support for ecosystem expansion and user growth.

As the AI Agent network, prediction markets, and global yield systems gradually open, UMXM will play an increasingly important role in the overall value cycle of the ecosystem.

The manadia ecosystem will officially open globally in June. At that time, a global value network built around trusted AI predictive capability will be launched.

In the past, the internet connected information. Later, blockchain connected assets. In the future, AI will connect value. As prediction begins to create value and value begins to flow freely, a new era of the AI Value Internet is emerging.

manadia goes global — a new world driven by prediction, powered by intelligent collaboration, and connected by value is about to begin.

item.title: How Can Beginners Use an AI Trading Robot? 5 Free AI Trading Robot Platforms Offering Trial Access
item.content:encoded:
For many beginners, the idea of using an AI trading robot sounds complicated. New traders often imagine advanced coding, exchange API settings, technical indicators, and trading systems that only experienced market participants can understand. In reality, the trading automation market has changed. In 2026, several platforms now offer free plans, demo tools, trial credits, or limited trial access so new users can explore automated trading before making larger decisions.

This does not mean automated trading is risk-free. A trading robot can help with market monitoring, rule-based execution, data organization, or strategy workflow support, but it cannot remove volatility or guarantee results. Beginners should treat any free plan or trial period as a learning stage, not as a shortcut to profits.

For users who want to understand how AI-assisted trading works, the best starting point is simple: review the platform interface, check supported markets, understand risk settings, and learn how automated strategy execution is organized.

Below are five platforms that offer some form of free plan, demo access, trial credit, or beginner entry point for new users in 2026.

Quick Comparison: 5 AI Trading Robot Platforms With Free or Trial Access

| Platform | Free Starting Point | Main Market Focus | Best For | |----|----|----|----| | BulkQuant | New user experience support, including trial credit | Crypto, forex, stocks | Beginners looking for a managed AI trading robot workflow | | 3Commas | 7-day trial access on selected paid plans | Crypto | Users who want hands-on crypto bot automation | | Cryptohopper | 3-day Explorer trial | Crypto | Beginners testing cloud-based bot automation | | Coinrule | Free Starter plan with limited rules | Crypto, stocks, ETFs | No-code rule-based trading automation | | Bitsgap | 7-day PRO trial with no credit card required | Crypto | Users testing Grid, DCA, demo tools, and AI-assisted crypto automation |

New users get $10 instant reward plus $50 free trial credit!

1. BulkQuant — A Managed AI Trading Robot Platform for Beginners

BulkQuant is designed for users who want a simpler way to explore automated strategy execution across crypto, forex, and stock market environments. Instead of asking beginners to build a bot from scratch, write code, or manage complex technical parameters, BulkQuant focuses on a more guided and managed platform experience.

The platform is built around AI-assisted market monitoring, automated strategy execution, and a dashboard-based workflow. This makes it relevant for users who want to understand how a managed AI trading robot can organize market activity without requiring constant manual operation.

For beginners, BulkQuant’s main appeal is its lower technical barrier. Many trading automation tools require users to connect exchanges, build custom strategies, test parameters, and monitor bot activity closely. BulkQuant positions itself around a more managed experience, where users can review platform tools, understand available trading workflows, and monitor account activity through a more accessible interface.

Free Starting Point

New users who register with BulkQuant may receive initial experience support, including account rewards and trial credit. This setup is mainly designed to help users become familiar with the platform interface, review automated trading workflows, and understand the basic operation of AI-assisted strategy execution with a lower entry threshold.

Why Beginners May Consider BulkQuant

BulkQuant may be useful for beginners who want:

  • A managed AI trading robot experience
  • A beginner-friendly trading dashboard
  • Crypto, forex, and stock market automation
  • Less manual setup than traditional bot tools
  • Automated strategy execution support
  • A simpler way to observe market monitoring and account activity

BulkQuant may be especially relevant for users who want to understand how trading automation works before moving into more advanced tools.

What Beginners Should Check First

Before using BulkQuant or any automated trading platform, users should review the platform rules, supported markets, account permissions, trading plans, risk controls, and fee structure. Trial access can help users learn the interface, but it does not remove trading risk.

2. 3Commas — Crypto Trading Bot Automation With Trial Access

3Commas is one of the better-known platforms in crypto trading automation. It offers tools for users who want to automate trading activity across supported exchanges through bots, smart trading features, and portfolio tools.

For beginners exploring crypto automation, 3Commas may be useful because it provides a structured environment for learning how trading bots operate. Depending on the selected plan, users can explore DCA bots, Grid bots, Signal bots, SmartTrade features, and other automation tools.

Unlike a fully managed platform, 3Commas gives users more direct control over configuration. That flexibility can be useful, but beginners should take time to understand each setting before activating live automation.

Free Starting Point

3Commas offers trial access on selected paid plans for new users. This can help beginners review the interface, understand bot limits, and compare automation tools before choosing a subscription.

Why Beginners May Consider 3Commas

3Commas may be suitable for users who want:

  • Crypto-focused trading bot automation
  • DCA and Grid bot tools
  • SmartTrade features
  • Exchange-connected automation
  • More control over bot configuration
  • A trial period before selecting a paid plan

For users who want to learn how bot settings work, 3Commas provides a more hands-on trading automation environment.

What Beginners Should Check First

Beginners should pay attention to exchange API permissions, supported exchanges, bot limits, backtesting tools, and whether the selected plan supports spot or futures trading. A crypto bot can execute quickly, so users should understand settings before using live funds.

3. Cryptohopper — Cloud-Based Crypto Bot Tools for New Users

Cryptohopper is a cloud-based crypto trading bot platform that allows users to automate trading strategies without keeping their own computer running. It supports trading bots, strategy tools, signals, copy trading features, and AI-related strategy functions on certain plans.

For beginners, Cryptohopper can be attractive because it combines automation with a marketplace-style ecosystem. Users can explore signals, templates, strategy design tools, and bot settings from one platform. This makes it useful for people who want to understand how cloud-based trading automation works in crypto markets.

Because Cryptohopper includes many features, beginners should avoid activating too many tools at once. A more practical approach is to start with one simple strategy, test the platform carefully, and understand how entries, exits, stop settings, and position limits work.

Free Starting Point

Cryptohopper offers a 3-day Explorer trial when users sign up. This gives beginners a short window to test the platform interface and understand its trading automation workflow.

Why Beginners May Consider Cryptohopper

Cryptohopper may be useful for users who want:

  • Cloud-based crypto trading automation
  • Strategy design tools
  • Trading signals and marketplace features
  • Portfolio and manual bot options
  • More customization than a managed platform
  • A short trial before upgrading

The platform is better suited for users who want to explore crypto bot automation with a higher level of customization.

What Beginners Should Check First

Users should review supported exchanges, strategy options, marketplace signal costs, and the limitations that apply after the trial period ends. Beginners should also avoid assuming that a copied or AI-ranked strategy automatically fits their risk tolerance.

4. Coinrule — No-Code Trading Automation for Rule-Based Strategies

Coinrule is a no-code trading automation platform that allows users to build rule-based strategies using conditions and actions. It is relevant for crypto users and also supports broader automation use cases through selected broker and exchange connections.

For beginners searching for a simple entry point, Coinrule’s main advantage is its visual rule builder. Users do not need to write code. Instead, they can create rules such as “if this condition happens, then take this action.” This makes the platform easier to understand for users who want to learn the logic behind automated trading.

Coinrule is different from a managed AI trading robot. It gives users more direct control over strategy rules. This can be useful for education, but it also means users need to understand what their rules are doing.

Free Starting Point

Coinrule offers a free Starter plan with limited live rules, demo rules, and other entry-level features. This allows beginners to test the platform and understand rule-based automation before moving to a paid plan.

Why Beginners May Consider Coinrule

Coinrule may be suitable for users who want:

  • No-code trading automation
  • A visual rule builder
  • Demo trading before live execution
  • Crypto, stock, and ETF automation options
  • Pre-built strategy templates
  • A free plan for learning basic automation logic

For beginners who want to understand how automated trading decisions are built, Coinrule can be a useful educational starting point.

What Beginners Should Check First

Users should check rule limits, supported exchanges or brokers, monthly volume limits, demo features, and whether advanced indicators require a paid plan. A simple rule can still create risk if the market moves sharply, so users should test carefully before live trading.

5. Bitsgap — Crypto Trading Bots, Demo Tools, and AI-Assisted Automation

Bitsgap is a crypto trading automation platform offering Grid bots, DCA bots, smart orders, demo trading, backtesting, and AI-assisted tools depending on the selected plan. It is especially known for crypto bot workflows across multiple exchanges.

For beginners, Bitsgap can be useful because it offers both demo features and trial access. This allows users to test the environment, review bot behavior, and understand how crypto trading automation works before using larger amounts of capital.

Bitsgap may be more suitable for users who want to explore practical crypto trading bot structures such as Grid and DCA systems. These tools can be helpful, but beginners need to understand when each strategy may or may not be suitable. A Grid bot, for example, may behave differently in a ranging market than in a strongly trending market.

Free Starting Point

Bitsgap offers a 7-day PRO trial with no credit card required. Its pricing page also lists plan options for users who want to continue after the trial period.

Why Beginners May Consider Bitsgap

Bitsgap may be relevant for users who want:

  • Crypto Grid and DCA bot tools
  • Demo trading access
  • Backtesting features
  • AI-assisted crypto automation tools
  • Smart orders and portfolio tools
  • Trial access before selecting a paid plan

For users who want to test crypto automation in a more structured environment, Bitsgap provides a useful learning path.

What Beginners Should Check First

Beginners should review bot limits, supported exchanges, demo versus live trading differences, Grid and DCA settings, futures availability, and how access changes after the trial period ends.

How Beginners Should Use a Free AI Trading Robot Trial

A free trial is most useful when beginners treat it as a learning tool. The goal should not be to activate every feature immediately. Instead, users should use the trial period to understand how the platform works.

1. Start With the Dashboard

Before activating any automation tool, spend time reviewing the dashboard. Look for supported markets, available strategy tools, account settings, risk controls, trading history, and help documentation.

2. Understand the Platform Type

Not every platform works the same way. Some are fully managed, some are no-code rule builders, some connect to exchanges through API keys, and some focus on demo trading. Beginners should understand whether the platform is managing the workflow, helping build rules, or simply providing tools.

3. Review Risk Settings

Risk controls matter more than speed. Before using automated strategy execution, check stop settings, position size rules, exposure limits, trading pairs, and whether the platform provides clear account monitoring.

4. Test One Strategy First

Beginners should avoid running several bots or strategies at the same time. Testing one simple workflow makes it easier to understand what the platform is doing.

5. Avoid Guaranteed-Profit Claims

A responsible trading automation platform should not promise fixed returns or risk-free results. Automated tools can support market monitoring and execution, but they cannot remove uncertainty from crypto, forex, or stock markets.

What Makes a Platform Beginner-Friendly?

A beginner-friendly AI trading robot platform usually has several qualities:

  • Clear onboarding
  • Simple dashboard design
  • Trial access or demo tools
  • No-code or low-code operation
  • Visible risk settings
  • Transparent pricing
  • Supported market information
  • Easy-to-understand strategy workflow
  • Account activity monitoring
  • Educational support or help documentation

The best platform for a beginner is not always the one with the most features. It is often the one that makes the trading workflow easiest to understand.

Final Thoughts

Beginners can use an AI trading robot in 2026 by starting slowly, choosing platforms with trial access, reviewing settings carefully, and treating automation as a tool rather than a shortcut.

BulkQuant, 3Commas, Cryptohopper, Coinrule, and Bitsgap each offer a different way to explore trading automation. BulkQuant focuses on a more managed workflow. 3Commas and Cryptohopper provide crypto-focused bot automation. Coinrule is useful for no-code rule-based strategies. Bitsgap offers crypto bot testing, demo tools, and AI-assisted features.

For new users, the most important step is not choosing the most advanced system. It is understanding how the platform works, what risks remain, and how automated strategy execution fits into a broader trading plan.

An AI trading robot can help organize market monitoring and automate certain workflows, but responsible use still depends on user awareness, risk review, and realistic expectations.

item.title: Solstice and Tensorx to Buy $1 Billion in AI Infrastructure to Support EU Sovereign AI Demand
item.content:encoded:
London, United Arab Emirates, June 25th, 2026/Chainwire/--TensorX and Solstice today announced a partnership to finance European sovereign AI infrastructure. TensorX and Solstice will work together to create a facility with up to $1 billion in capacity to finance AI hardware and data-center build-out to meet rising demand for sovereign compute across the EU.

Solstice will provide the onchain financing for that buildout and will launch aiUSX, a potential yield asset that opens the same infrastructure lending to companies holding capital for AI.

TensorX owns and operates a fleet of NVIDIA GPUs and delivers AI models in EU data centres with zero data retention, predictable pricing with best-in-class performance. The company works with AI startups and enterprises across the EU block with plans to expand into other global jurisdictions.

"Europe wants AI that can run on its own terms, on its own soil, without handing its data to someone else's cloud on the world stage," said Tim Grant, Executive Chairman of TensorX. "Meeting that accelerating demand takes hardware, and a lot of it. The billion dollars going into GPUs and data center capacity is the first step, and we expect to keep buying as demand grows. Solstice gives us a financing partner that can keep pace with this incredibly fast moving market."

aiUSX: Financing the AI Buildout With Capital Companies Already Hold

Companies hold growing piles of cash and stable assets for their AI spend while inference bills climb. These two pools sit apart, and the cash earns nothing while it waits. aiUSX closes that gap. The capital a company sets aside for AI goes into aiUSX, which opens access to the AI-infrastructure lending Solstice finances, the same deals large institutions fund.

The company takes the position of an infrastructure lender without becoming one or underwriting anything itself; for example, USD.ai has brought capital to AI hardware across the wider buildout. At launch, aiUSX will be capped at $5 million, with yield generated by the lending it gives access to. The capital stays liquid and redeemable, and what it earns goes toward the cost of inference later.

"Every company is turning into an AI company, and every one of them watches its inference bill climb," said Ben Nadareski, CEO of Solstice. "aiUSX puts the money they set aside for AI to work in the meantime. They get access to the kind of AI-infrastructure lending that used to sit with large institutions, the capital stays liquid, and what it earns goes toward inference later. It is treasury management for the AI era."

\

"Sovereign AI is one of the biggest infrastructure buildouts of this decade, and it runs on capital as much as it runs on chips," said Stuart Connolly, CIO of Deus X Capital. "TensorX builds the compute, Solstice brings the financing, and aiUSX lets more companies take part in funding it. Both companies are in the Deus X Capital ecosystem, which is why we’re uniquely positioned to deliver this to the market."

About Solstice

Solstice is an onchain settlement and yield protocol and part of the Deus X Capital ecosystem. Its dollar-denominated asset, USX, and its treasury products provide institutions and businesses with capital that remains liquid and productive. Solstice has a three-year audited track record and more than $500 million in total value locked.

https://solstice.finance/

About TensorX

TensorX is a sovereign AI infrastructure company based in Dublin. It buys and operates AI hardware and data-center capacity across the EU, connects clients to private compute, and keeps prompts and data on European infrastructure with full data residency and zero retention.

https://tensorx.ai/
